properties.name: A0429/26 / OKAC
properties.originalText:
DUE TO OPERATIONAL RESTRICTIONS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR ( OKAC ) : 
 
KUWAIT FIR IS AVAILABLE FOR FLIGHTS ARR OR DEP WITHIN KUWAIT FIR 
SUBJECT TO PRIOR APPROVAL FROM KUWAIT DGCA AIR TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT. 
 
OVERFLIGHT TFC OPERATING BTN BAHRAIN FIR ( OBBB ) 
AND BAGHDAD FIR ( ORBB ) VIA KUWAIT FIR ( OKAC ) 
IS PERMITTED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS VIA PUBLISHED ATS ROUTES 
FL 280 AND ABOVE SUBJECT TO PRIOR APPROVAL FROM KUWAIT DGCA AIR 
TRANSPORT DEPARTMENT, FLOW CONTROL MEASURES AND ATC CLEARANCE. 
 
ALL OTHER OVERFLIGHT OPERATIONS THROUGH KUWAIT FIR NOT PERMITTED. 
 
FLIGHTS DEPARTING FROM OR ARRIVING AT AIRPORTS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR 
TO/FROM BAGHDAD FIR ( ORBB ) ARE NOT PERMITTED. 
 
 
DEPARTING TFC FROM AIRPORTS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR 
SHALL USE THE FOLLOWING ROUTING : 
 
A.TFC DESTINED TO AIRPORTS WITHIN OBBB FIR OR OVERFLYING 
 OBBB FIR FOR DESTINATIONS OUTSIDE OBBB FIR SHALL FILE IN ACCORDANCE 
WITH THE NORMAL ROUTING ARRANGEMENTS BETWEEN OKAC AND OBBB FIRS AS 
APPLICABLE TO DESTINATION. 
 
B.TFC DESTINED TO AIRPORTS WITHEN JEDDAH FIR ( OEJD ) OR OVERFLYING 
JEDDAH FIR SHALL FILE VIA NIDAP L550 OR DEKOB P517 OR KATOD G667 OR 
ASVIR H741 AS APPROPRIATE TO DESTINATION. 
 
ARRIVING TFC AIRPORTS WITHIN KUWAIT FIR SHALL USE THE FOLLOWING ENTRY 
ROUTES: 
 
A.TFC ARRIVING FROM OBBB FIR SHALL FILE VIA KUMBO A453. 
 
B.TFC ARRIVING FROM OEJD FIR SHALL FILE VIA KUNRU P891 OR SOROR A788 
OR H741 ASVIR. 
 
OPERATORS SHALL CARRY SUFFICIENT FUEL TO ACCOMMODATE POSSIBLE DELAYS 
OR DIVERSION REQUIREMENTS DUE TO TACTICAL REASONS.
